cues.zh: 各位好，歡迎來到大數據總覽；本節會先介紹 Hadoop、MapReduce、Spark 和 PySpark。

cues.en: We'll explain what a local system is a distributed system.
cues.zh: 我們會說明本機系統與分散式系統。

cues.en: Afterwards we'll get an overview of the Hadoop ecosystem then we'll switch gears have a detailed overview of Sparke and we'll show you how to set up Jupiter Sparc and everything you need on Amazon Web Services
cues.zh: 接著總覽 Hadoop 生態系，再詳細介紹 Spark，示範在 Amazon Web Services 上設定 Jupyter、Spark 和所需工具。

cues.en: will also give you some resources or other SPARC options in case you want to install SPARC locally or on some other system.
cues.zh: 也會提供其他 Spark 選項與資源，供你在本機或其他系統安裝。

cues.en: Afterwards we'll dive right in into the Jupiter notebook with hands on code learning about pi Sparc and Ardie these and we'll learn about these and what that stands for in the next lecture.
cues.zh: 然後直接進入 Jupyter Notebook，實際寫程式學習 PySpark 和 RDD；下一堂會介紹 RDD 及其全名。

cues.en: Let's talk about big data in general.
cues.zh: 先談談大數據。

cues.en: So far we've worked of data that can fit onto a local computer and that's usually in the scale of somewhere between 0 and 8 gigabytes.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，我們處理的資料都能放進本機電腦，通常大約在零到 8 GB 之間。

cues.en: That's just data that can fit directly onto your RAM.
cues.zh: 也就是能直接放進 RAM 的資料。

cues.en: But what can we do if we have a larger set of data.
cues.zh: 但如果資料集更大呢？

cues.en: You could try using some sort of sequel database to move storage onto your hard drive instead of RAM that will still work on a local computer that if you need to expand beyond what your local machine can
cues.zh: 可以試著使用 SQL 資料庫，把儲存位置從 RAM 移到硬碟，這仍可在本機進行；但若需要超過本機能力，

cues.en: do you can use what's known as a distributed system that distributes the data to multiple machines or computers.
cues.zh: 就能使用所謂分散式系統，把資料分配到多台機器或電腦。

cues.en: Just to reiterate a local machine is basically what we've been using.
cues.zh: 再說一次，本機基本上就是我們一直在用的方式。

cues.en: It's your own computer or a single machine where you're restricted to the RAM or hard drive of that one machine on a distributed system.
cues.zh: 你的電腦或單一機器，受限於那台機器的 RAM 或硬碟；而分散式系統中，

cues.en: You can have one machine controlling a distribution of multiple machines.
cues.zh: 可以由一台機器控制多台分散的機器。

cues.en: For instance if you have one local machine you may use all the cores on that machine.
cues.zh: 例如只有一台本機時，可以使用那台機器的所有核心。

cues.en: However if you leverage the power of a distributed system you can have one smaller master node controlling
cues.zh: 但運用分散式系統，就能由較小的主節點控制，

cues.en: a distributed system of computers that allows you to take advantage of this distributed system and actually retain more processing power and more memory than you would be able to on a single local machine.
cues.zh: 一群分散式電腦，利用它們取得比單一本機更多的處理能力與記憶體。

cues.en: And that's what we're going to be discussing as we talk about Hadoop and map reduce as I previously
cues.zh: 接下來討論 Hadoop 和 MapReduce 時，就會介紹這些；如前所述，

cues.en: mentioned a local process will use the computational resources of just the single machine a distributed process will have access to the computational resources across a number of machines connected through
cues.zh: 本機程序只使用單台機器的計算資源，分散式程序則能使用多台機器的計算資源，這些機器透過，

cues.en: a network after a certain point.
cues.zh: 網路連接。到了某個規模，

cues.en: It's much easier to scale out to many lower CPQ machines than it is to try to scale up to a single machine
cues.zh: 橫向擴充成許多 CPU 能力較低的機器，比垂直升級單台，

cues.en: with the high CPQ distributed machines also have the advantage of easily scaling.
cues.zh: 高 CPU 能力的機器容易得多。分散式機器也有容易擴充的優勢。

cues.en: You can just easily add more machines versus a single local machine.
cues.zh: 直接增加機器就好；相較之下，單一本機，

cues.en: It's much harder to actually upgrade the Sipa you and you're going to reach a certain limit.
cues.zh: 要升級 CPU 困難得多，也會碰到某種極限。

cues.en: Distributed machines can also include something known as fault tolerance which basically means if one machine fails the whole network can still go on versus a local machine if that goes down your entire
cues.zh: 分散式機器也能提供所謂容錯能力，基本上是一台機器失效時，整個網路仍能繼續運作；但本機一旦故障，整個，

cues.en: work goes down.
cues.zh: 工作就停了。

cues.en: Now let's go ahead and discuss the typical format of a distributed architecture that uses Hadoop as a basic overview.
cues.zh: 現在簡單總覽，以 Hadoop 為基礎的典型分散式架構。

cues.en: Hadoop is essentially just the way to distribute very large files across multiple machines.
cues.zh: Hadoop 基本上能把超大檔案分散到多台機器。

cues.en: It uses what is known as the Hadoop distributed file system or HFS HFS allows a user to work with large data sets.
cues.zh: 它使用 Hadoop Distributed File System，也就是 HDFS，讓使用者處理大型資料集。

cues.en: And that also duplicates blocks of data for fault tolerance.
cues.zh: 也會複製資料區塊，提供容錯能力。

cues.en: It can then also use what's known as map reduce and map redos allows computations on that data.
cues.zh: 然後能使用 MapReduce，在這些資料上進行計算。

cues.en: Let's go in and take a look at what a distributed storage or HFS system would look like.
cues.zh: 看看分散式儲存，也就是 HDFS 系統會長什麼樣子。

cues.en: You would have your main name node with some CPQ and ram attached to it and then you would have several other distributed machines as data nodes.
cues.zh: 有一個主要的 NameNode，搭配 CPU 與 RAM，還有多台分散式機器作為 DataNode。

cues.en: Will use blocks of data usually of a size of 128 megabytes by default.
cues.zh: 資料以區塊儲存，預設大小通常是 128 MB。

cues.en: And each of these blocks is replicated three times and then the blocks are distributed in a way support fault tolerance meaning if one of these lower data nodes gets knocked out for some reason you have your
cues.zh: 每個區塊複製三份，再以支援容錯的方式分配；也就是其中一個下方的 DataNode 因故失效時，

cues.en: data replicated on the other nodes.
cues.zh: 其他節點仍有資料複本。

cues.en: So you're not going to lose any information.
cues.zh: 所以不會遺失資訊。

cues.en: Smaller blocks provide more paralyzation during processing multiple copies of a block prevent loss of data due to a failure of a node.
cues.zh: 區塊較小，處理時能有更多平行化；同一區塊有多份複本，能避免節點故障造成資料遺失。

cues.en: Now let's talk about map reduce map reduce as a way of splitting a computation task to a distributed set of files such as the FS.
cues.zh: 現在談 MapReduce；它能將計算任務拆分，分配給像 HDFS 這樣的分散式檔案集合。

cues.en: It consists of a job tracker and multiple task trackers.
cues.zh: 它包含一個 JobTracker，以及多個 TaskTracker。

cues.en: The job tracker sends code to run on the task trackers those task trackers allocate CPQ and memory for
cues.zh: JobTracker 把程式碼送到 TaskTracker 執行；TaskTracker 會配置 CPU 與記憶體，

cues.en: the tasks and monitor the tasks on the worker nodes.
cues.zh: 給任務使用，並監控工作節點上的任務。

cues.en: What we covered can be thought of in two distinct parts using HFS to distribute large data sets and then using map reduce to distribute a computational task to a distributed dataset.
cues.zh: 剛才的內容可以分成兩部分：用 HDFS 分散大型資料集，再用 MapReduce 把計算任務分配到分散式資料集。

cues.en: Next we're going to be learning about is the latest technology in the space which is known as SPARK spark improves on the concepts of using distribution.
cues.zh: 接下來要學的是這個領域的新技術 Spark，它改進了使用分散式運算的概念。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Up next we're going to learn about SPARK spark can use Hadoop distributed file system but it has many advantages to just using map reduce.
cues.zh: 下一堂要介紹 Spark；它可以使用 Hadoop 分散式檔案系統，但比單純使用 MapReduce 有許多優勢。

cues.en: Thanks everyone and I'll see you at the next lecture where we learn more about Sparc and how we're going to use it in this course.
cues.zh: 謝謝各位，下堂會進一步學習 Spark，以及本課程如何使用它。
